notes.subject: Ruakh
notes.rationale: רוח ke modu o tee — phefo, moya, maemodumo; ka mošomo wa phefo mo, fela leina le bolokwa.

notes.subject: maphego
notes.rationale: בכנפיה: 'maphego' (ja nonyana, KJV/ASV) kgahlanong le 'dikobo tša yona' (JPS, maphego a aparwa) — leina le tee, diswantšho tše pedi.

notes.subject: ba tla swaba
notes.rationale: יבשו le ka bala 'ba tla omela' — go swaba le go oma le tloga go tlwaelega go leina letee.

translation: Ruakh e mo kotile ⟨את⟩ ka maphego a yona, gomme ba tla swaba ka mahlabelo a bona.
